y1: Very early on Sunday morning, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to the tomb. Suddenly, there was a great earthquake. An angel came down, rolled away the stone, and sat on it.
y2: The angel said, “Don't be afraid. Jesus is not here. He has risen, just as He said! Come and see the place where He lay.”
y4: The women ran to tell the disciples, filled with both fear and great joy. Suddenly, Jesus met them and said, “Greetings!”
y5: The women held Jesus' feet and worshiped Him. Jesus said, “Don't be afraid. Go and tell My brothers to go to Galilee. They will see Me there.”
y7: The soldiers guarding the tomb went to the chief priests and told them what had happened. The chief priests gave the soldiers a lot of money and said:
y8: “Say that His disciples came at night and stole His body.” They spread the lie, but they couldn't stop the truth. Jesus truly rose from the dead!
y10: The eleven disciples went to the mountain in Galilee, saw Jesus, and worshiped Him. Jesus said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to Me. Therefore go and make disciples of all nations.”
y11: “Baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit, and teach them to obey everything I have commanded you. And remember, I am with you always, to the end of the age!”
verse: “Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”
prayer: Risen Jesus, thank You for conquering death and rising again! Hallelujah! I believe that You are always with me to the end of the age, even when I am afraid. Let me also be a disciple who spreads Your joyful news. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: angel. A heavenly messenger who delivers God's word. An angel rolled away the stone of the tomb.
d1: resurrection. To die and come back to life again. Jesus rose on the third day.
d2: lie. Saying something that is not true as if it were true. The chief priests spread a lie.
d3: disciple. A person who follows Jesus and learns from Him. Make disciples of all nations.
d4: baptize. A sign with water received by a person who believes in Jesus. Baptize them in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
